title: Factors influencing continuance intention for online consultations among survivors of cancer: grounded theory study
core_idea: To explore, using grounded theory qualitative methods, the factors that influence cancer survivors' willingness to continue using online consultation platforms and to develop a theoretical model explaining continuance intention to inform survivor-centered digital health strategies.
tldr: Grounded-theory interviews with adult cancer survivors in southwest China aim to identify influences on continued use of online consultations and produce a theoretical model to guide survivor-centered digital health services.
